title: Fixed Rope Stanchion Barrier
description: One original static stylized rope barrier with two broad finite circular-foot stanchions, integral narrow shafts and faceted heads, two fixed solid mounting studs, two solid rope-end ferrules and one continuous thick sagging rope. The complete assembly is one prop and seven closed editable meshes. The rope joins both ferrules, both studs join the heads, and the bases have true planar finite ground contact. The open space below the rope remains clear. Four constant solid PBR materials, metre scale, source Z up, front -Y and ground-centre origin. Generic exhibition and queue appearance suitable for reuse without duplicating themed recolours; no claim of specific modular or corner compatibility. Static visual geometry only: no rope physics, tension, motion, crowd control, barrier effectiveness, load capacity, stability, anti-tip, installation, accessibility, escape-route, manufacturing, real product dimensional compliance or public safety certification. No display plinths, people, floor or accessory set.
